description: Start a site-wide analysis and let it pick its own pages: the homepage first, then the sections covering the most pages, since a template problem there repeats across the site. Spends one credit per page scanned, so it can cost a lot at once; the plan cap and the credits left both apply and the smaller wins. When connected through OAuth (for example from Claude), a run scans at most 25 pages unless you pass max_pages. Returns immediately. Over an API key it requires the Start site analyses (site:analyze) scope.

exclude.description: Never scan URLs matching these. Applied after include.

include.description: Only scan URLs matching these patterns. `*` is the wildcard.

max_pages.description: Your own ceiling on pages, and therefore on credits

name: start_site_analysis
title: Scan a whole site
